results.title: The Big E | Directions & Parking
results.content:
Public parking for The Big E is located at Gate 9.
Continue approximately 3/4 mi. to ESE’s Gate 9 public parking lot.
There are no ATMs near Gate 9.
Motorcycles park on the grounds at Gate 9.
Cars are $10 per vehicle at Gate 9 and motorcycles are $5.
An additional charge of $10 will apply for vehicle parking per space per day.
